title: Uniqueness, multiplication, unit and identity from normalized fractions
statement: Let $R,S,A,B$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure on $S$, an $R$-algebra structure on $A$, and an $S$-algebra structure on $B$. Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ and $B=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}B_n$ be graded rings with $A_n$ an $R$-submodule and $B_n$ an $S$-submodule. Fix ring maps $\rho_A:R\to A_0$ and $\rho_B:S\to B_0$ whose composites into $A$ and $B$ are the specified algebra maps. Let $\beta:S\otimes_R A\simeq B$ be an $S$-algebra isomorphism and $\psi:A\to B$ a graded ring map such that $\beta(1\otimes a)=\psi(a)$ and $B_n=\operatorname{span}_S\psi(A_n)$ for every $n$. Write $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$, $Q=\operatorname{Proj}(B)$ and use their standard opens and chart inclusions [lem-nagata-affine-proj-scalar-extension], their twisting module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Suppose $r:Q\to P$ satisfies $r^{-1}D_+(f)=D_+(\psi(f))$ for every positive-degree homogeneous $f$, and on this chart is the spectrum map of $A_{(f)}\to B_{(\psi(f))}$ induced by $\psi$. Fix a family $\theta_j:r^*\mathcal O_P(j)\simeq\mathcal O_Q(j)$ satisfying [def-sfb-proj-scalar-extension-twist-normalization]. Then (1) every other normalized family equals $\theta$; (2) for sections $s,t,v$ of twists $i,j,i+j$ on any open $U\subseteq P$ with $v=st$ pointwise, their transported sections satisfy $\theta_{i+j}(1\otimes v)=\theta_i(1\otimes s)\theta_j(1\otimes t)$ pointwise on $r^{-1}U$; (3) in degree zero, applying $\theta_0$ to the pullback of the canonical map $\mathcal O_P\to\mathcal O_P(0)$ agrees with the canonical map $\mathcal O_Q\to\mathcal O_Q(0)$ applied to $r^\sharp$ on every open; and (4) for any family $\iota_j:\operatorname{id}_P^*\mathcal O_P(j)\simeq\mathcal O_P(j)$ normalized for the identity graded ring map and identity scheme map, $\iota_j$ is the identity-pullback isomorphism induced by the section-normalized adjunction for every $j$.

proof.text: For two given normalized comparisons, local homogeneous fractions determine their maps: on an open with b invertible, psi(b) is invertible and the denominator-multiplied normalization determines theta(1 tensor a/b). The affine pullback-sections theorem says these sections with coefficients generate. Affine faithfulness and gluing give equality of the maps, and isomorphism extensionality and funext give equality of the families.

proof.text: Multiplication is respected on each $U_f$: on two pure tensors $(a/f^m)\otimes c$ and $(b/f^n)\otimes e$, the two orders of comparison and multiplication both give $ce\,\psi(ab)/\psi(f)^{m+n}$. Balancing and additivity extend this to all tensors. The affine quasi-coherent tensor-sections theorem identifies these tensor modules with the section modules of the sheaf tensor products. The canonical pullback--tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor] sends $r^*(u\otimes v)$ to $r^*u\otimes r^*v$; on the chart it is therefore precisely the rebracketing $(u\otimes c)\otimes(v\otimes e)\mapsto(u\otimes v)\otimes ce$; its inverse sends $(u\otimes v)\otimes c$ to $(u\otimes1)\otimes(v\otimes c)$, so the comparison in this diagram is the canonical one. The local product formulas also define the twist multiplication maps, since multiplication of graded fractions commutes with restrictions. The unit is $1/1$, sent to $1/1$; at $j=0$ the formula $h\otimes c\mapsto c\psi(h)$ is exactly the structural identification $r^*\mathcal O_P\cong\mathcal O_Q$.  This proves only the product and degree-zero unit assertions; the homogeneous-section formula is proved directly in the parent.

proof.text: For the identity coefficient extension, the normalized adjunction unit and left-adjoint uniqueness give the identity-pullback comparison on sections by u tensor c mapped to cu. This satisfies the identity normalized fraction law. The preceding uniqueness argument therefore identifies any given normalized identity comparison with tensorPullbackSectionId, degree by degree.

theorem scalarExtension_twist_fraction_laws
    {R S A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S B]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) (ℬ : ℕ → Submodule S B)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (ρA : R →+* 𝒜 0) (ρB : S →+* ℬ 0)
    (hρA : ∀ a : R, (ρA a : A) = algebraMap R A a)
    (hρB : ∀ b : S, (ρB b : B) = algebraMap S B b)
    (β : TensorProduct R S A ≃ₐ[S] B) (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hβψ : ∀ a : A, β (TensorProduct.tmul R (1 : S) a) = ψ a)
    (hgraded : ∀ n : ℕ, ℬ n = Submodule.span S (ψ '' (𝒜 n : Set A)))
    (r : Proj ℬ ⟶ Proj 𝒜)
    (hpre : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : A), f ∈ 𝒜 n → 0 < n →
      r ⁻¹ᵁ basicOpen 𝒜 f = basicOpen ℬ (ψ f))
    (hchart : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 n) (hn : 0 < n),
      awayι ℬ (ψ f) (ψ.map_mem hf) hn ≫ r =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map ψ f)) ≫
          awayι 𝒜 f hf hn)
    (θ : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback r).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist ℬ j)
    (hθ : IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison ψ r θ) :
    (∀ θ' : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback r).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist ℬ j,
        IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison ψ r θ' → θ' = θ) ∧
      (∀ (i j : ℤ) (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens)
        (s : Γ(twist 𝒜 i, U)) (t : Γ(twist 𝒜 j, U))
        (v : Γ(twist 𝒜 (i + j), U)),
        (∀ x : U, (v.1 x : Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
          (s.1 x : Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) * t.1 x) →
        ∀ x : r ⁻¹ᵁ U,
          ((scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ (i + j) U v).1 x :
            Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
          ((scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ i U s).1 x :
            Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) *
          (scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ j U t).1 x) ∧
      (∀ (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (s : Γ(Proj 𝒜, U)),
        scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ 0 U
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitToTwistZero (𝒜 := 𝒜)) U s) =
          Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitToTwistZero (𝒜 := ℬ)) (r ⁻¹ᵁ U) (r.app U s)) ∧
(∀ ι : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback (𝟙 (Proj 𝒜))).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist 𝒜 j,
        IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison (GradedRingHom.id 𝒜) (𝟙 (Proj 𝒜)) ι →
        ∀ j : ℤ, ι j = (tensorPullbackSectionId (Proj 𝒜)).app (twist 𝒜 j))
